dedupe_keys.name: evtol battery duty cycle and internal resistance data

description: The eVTOL battery research team publishes lithium-ion cell measurements under electric-aircraft duty profiles. The baseline sequence uses high-power takeoff, lower-power cruise and high-power landing, followed by cooling and charging stages. Trials vary ambient temperature, cruise length, aircraft power and charging current. Original CSVs provide voltage, temperature and current histories, with separate CSVs of processed internal resistance and a README. The deposit is free under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is controlled laboratory cycling, not operational flights or a geographic fleet sample. The data can calibrate battery degradation and state-estimation simulations, and offer a demanding duty-cycle comparison for storage studies such as model-system-advisor-model-sam. A caveat is that aircraft-cell conditions cannot directly represent complete battery packs or stationary storage. The file manifest contains different numbers of cycling and impedance files, so paired availability should be checked. No measurement file was downloaded.
